title: Three-op-amp instrumentation amplifier
goal: A reader must be able to trace a differential input through two gain-setting buffers and a matched-resistor difference stage to one output.

rubric.must: Two op-amp triangles are visible, each receiving one of VIN+ and VIN-.
The resistor labelled RG bridges the two inverting-input nodes of the input op-amp triangles.
Each input op-amp has a 10 kΩ feedback resistor from its output to its inverting node.
The two buffer outputs feed a third op-amp triangle through a four-resistor difference network, with one clearly marked OUT terminal.
The four difference-stage resistors are visibly labelled 10 kΩ, 0.1%.
Both +15 V and −15 V supply wires are visibly attached to every op-amp triangle.
VIN+ and VIN- are separately labelled and can be traced without ambiguity.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. RG bridges the two buffer inverting nodes with R1/R2 as their feedback, the difference stage carries the matched R3-R6 network, and the supplies sit in their own labelled block.
